column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Golgotha prison escape / Piripo
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Can't sleep!?
You were having such awful nightmares... I was worried...
You're a good person... so why were you put in a place like this...?!
I see...
Your $$ご主人様$$ has black $$羽$$ like us, but...
they fell for you... even though you're a $$奴隷$$ with white $$羽$$...
Right in front of the $$異端審問官$$...
They said $$愛$$ without being scared...
I couldn't even imagine that kind of courage...
So it really isn't $$発情$$...
or $$執着心$$ or $$所有欲$$... It's a special feeling, right?!
Even among people with black $$羽$$...
I've heard that very rarely, even between parents and children or siblings, a feeling like that can grow...
But they say even that is just an instinct to preserve the $$種族$$...
That's what they taught us...
You're worried about your $$ご主人様$$...
And that's why you want to get out of here.
I... I don't really understand
this thing called $$愛$$...
but somehow, it sounds wonderful.
I was born into a fairly well-off family with black $$羽$$,
so for now, I'm not accused of one of the $$七つの大罪$$—the $$罪$$ of $$弱者$$—but...
I was born frail, and my parents didn't want anyone to see me...
So they deliberately made me a guard in this sunless underground prison...
Because they'd be in trouble if anyone found out about me...
Does $$愛$$ really exist in $$この世$$?!
Hurry... Run away!!
When everyone was picking on me earlier... only you...
Only you didn't laugh at me.
The other guards...
Even prisoners with black $$羽$$ wouldn't give the time of day to a cowardly, weak person like me...
But you were the only one who listened seriously...!!
A coward like me... left alone, everyone will beat me to death someday...
My parents wanted that from the beginning—that's why they put me here!
Somehow... I'm jealous of you...
If only I...
could be reborn with a healthy body like yours,
and if I could find a $$ご主人様$$ to $$愛$$ too...
even if I were reborn a $$奴隷$$ with white $$羽$$, like you...
I know I wouldn't regret it!
Does $$愛$$ really exist in $$この世$$?
W-What?!
Ohho!!
N-no mistake! That is the sign of the $$邪神$$...
the sign of the $$救世主$$, heralding the $$大邪神$$'s return!!
M-my wounds hurt so badly, but... they're completely healed!!
Hey... $$ピリポ$$!!
Y-you... your back...
Your $$羽$$ have turned pure white!?
W-what's happening to me?!
What are you doing?! Get out of there, quickly!!
If you don't flee now, the other guards will be here any moment...
What should I do?! What am I supposed to do?!
Isn't it obvious?!
You're going to $$脱獄$$ with us!
If those guards find you here after your $$羽$$ have turned white,
do you think they'll just leave you alone?!
Come on—hurry and open all the other cells!
There aren't enough of us on our own...
But!?
M-me too?!
Don't you want to help me rescue this guy's $$ご主人様$$ too...
and see what they look like...?!
His $$飼い主$$, huh...
Bet they look evil as hell...!
Stay sharp! They're here!!
